name: Pixel separation for bright foreground
definition: A technique to correct incorrect blurring of bright pixels in low depths (foreground) against dark backgrounds by splitting the input into two separate scattering images: one for separated bright pixels ($L_{ssc}$) and one for the rest ($L_{sc}$).
summary: Pixel separation for bright foreground prevents bright foreground objects from losing intensity against dark backgrounds by isolating them, unlike the Visual Hull Oracle Kernel which focuses on visual hull approximation.
